_readme: Copy this file to bridge/agents.json to add AI command-line tools to ResumeFit. In args, {PROMPT} is replaced by the prompt (otherwise it is sent on stdin) and {OUT} by a temporary file the tool can write its answer to. Restart the helper after editing. Only add tools you trust: they run on your computer.
